question:
In the picture there is a square tile with two fourths of a circle. The radius of every fourth is half the side of the tile and its length equals $5 \mathrm{dm}$. A large square is formed from 16 such tiles. What is the maximum possible length of an unbroken continuous curve consisting of the fourths?
<image1>
Choices:
A:$75 \mathrm{dm}$
B:$100 \mathrm{dm}$
C:$105 \mathrm{dm}$
D:$110 \mathrm{dm}$
E:$80 \mathrm{dm}$
